description: Use before buying or holding a Solana token to see who really holds it: which top holders were funded from the same address, real concentration after merging linked wallets, holder and liquidity dynamics from our snapshot history, blacklist proximity within two transfers, and the mint's authorities and Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, hook, permanent delegate). Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Goes deeper than a single safety score such as RugCheck's. Price: 0.030 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.
name: token_deep_check
title: Holder graph and history for a token
